vehicle.notes: UK RHD. L/R = vehicle's own left/right (L = UK nearside / N/S / passenger side; R = offside / O/S / driver side); sellers' LH/RH and left/right are used in the same sense. Numbers were read from web-search results (titles and extracts) of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked. Two number styles appear: Stellantis 10-character numbers (mostly ending 80; some end in letters as listed, e.g. ...XT, ...1T, ...9V, ...A) and older GM-style 8-digit numbers (39xxxxxx). Dealers may supersede either. Only numbers that a source states for the Corsa F were recorded; Peugeot 208 Mk2 sources were not used. Pre-facelift (2019-2023) and facelift (2023-) front-end parts, headlamps and badges differ. Several numbers come from aftermarket listings quoting the OE reference, flagged in notes. Coverage is partial (21 searches): no door shells, arch liners, front bumper reinforcement, radiator/condenser (listings conflicted), wheels or TPMS numbers could be tied to a source. Verify every number by VIN.
